t: This is Canada House, a Greek Revival building on Trafalgar Square. It has been the chancery of the High Commission of Canada in the United Kingdom since 1925, and it is a Grade II* listed building, protected since 1970. It was designed by Sir Robert Smirke, one of the leaders of Greek Revival architecture. He also designed the main block and façade of the British Museum, and he was known for his accuracy and professionalism. Look at the building's classical lines and you are seeing his style at work.
